lesson.subtitle: Lesson 6 -- Inside the Factory
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Carlos Henrique Rodrigues | Lesson 6 -- Inside the Factory
lesson.grammar_point: can and cannot for permission and ability (you can, you cannot, Can I...?)

listenings.text: Good morning, everyone, and welcome. My name is Laura, and I am your guide. The tour is about two hours. Before we start, here are the rules. You can ask questions at any time. You can walk next to the machines, but you cannot touch them. You cannot take photos inside the factory. But in the museum, you can take all the photos you want. Please stay with the group. Let's go!

Hi, I am Tom, your instructor. Can you drive? Good. Can I see your driver's license? Thank you. Here are the rules. You can drive this car, but you cannot drive alone. I am in the car with you. You can drive three laps. On the first lap, you can't go fast. On the second and third laps, you can go faster. Are you ready? Okay, let's go.

extra_audio.text: BMW invites Carlos to Germany. Carlos and his son land in Frankfurt. The guide says: you cannot take photos. At Porsche, they can drive on the test track. In Munich, they visit the BMW Museum. After the trip, his son changes his career.

paras: Carlos rents cars in Brazil, so BMW invites him to Germany. His son goes with him. They land in Frankfurt, and they go to the factory. There is a guide, and the tour is in English.

The rules are simple. You can ask questions. You can see the robots and the new engines. But you cannot take photos inside the factory, and you cannot touch the cars. The son asks many questions. He can understand every step.

Then they visit Porsche in Leipzig. There is a test track there, and visitors can drive with an instructor. In Munich, they can see the BMW Museum. After this trip, the son changes his career. Carlos says: that trip opened his eyes.
